abi: function getBounty(uint256 id) view returns (string question, uint256 reward, uint256 deadline, string source, address resolver, uint256 bond, uint256 forecastCount, uint8 state, int256 trueValue, int256 winningForecast, address winner)
function getPosition(uint256 id, address participant) view returns (bool submitted, uint256 bondLocked, bool canWithdraw, bool canClaim)
function getForecasts(uint256 id) view returns ((address submitter, int256 value)[])
function createBounty(string question, uint256 reward, uint256 deadline, string source) returns (uint256 id)
event BountyCreated(uint256 indexed id, address indexed creator, string question, uint256 reward, uint256 deadline, string source, address resolver, uint256 bond)
event ForecastSubmitted(uint256 indexed id, address indexed forecaster, uint256 bond)
event BountyResolved(uint256 indexed id, int256 trueValue, address winner, int256 winningForecast)
event BondWithdrawn(uint256 indexed id, address indexed participant, uint256 amount)
event RewardClaimed(uint256 indexed id, address indexed winner, uint256 amount)
function allowance(address owner, address spender) view returns (uint256)
function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) returns (bool)
